label: Offerings
title: What Neryva can build.
description: These solution categories are the commercial expression of the company. They should remain concrete, selective, and tied to real operational value.

items.title: Enterprise AI Assistants
items.description: Custom assistants for secure knowledge access, document reasoning, and workflow support.
items.value: Reduce time spent searching, summarizing, and routing internal work.

items.title: Knowledge and Search Systems
items.description: Retrieval, semantic search, and document intelligence for internal and customer-facing use cases.
items.value: Make company knowledge easier to find, use, and trust.

items.title: AI Workflow Automation
items.description: Automation for repeatable enterprise workflows across operations, support, finance, compliance, and engineering.
items.value: Reduce repetitive work while keeping human oversight where it matters.

items.title: AI Efficiency and Deployment
items.description: Evaluation, latency reduction, inference cost analysis, and deployment support for production systems.
items.value: Lower operational cost and improve reliability in production AI systems.

items.title: Domain AI Solutions
items.description: Applied systems for vertical use cases in energy, clinical validation, robotics, or other domains when the opportunity is justified.
items.value: Translate research into a domain-specific product only when the problem is ready.
